evidence_required: Direction of the pause for each host and the likely location of the bottleneck.

marking.criterion: Host A (rx_prio3_pause rising): receives pauses from the switch; victim; bottleneck downstream in the fabric or a slow receiver elsewhere
Host B (tx_prio3_pause rising): sends pauses because its own receive path cannot drain
Host B identified as likely culprit with a host-side bottleneck location (PCIe, memory, slow consumer, receive buffers)

title: Who is pausing whom?
